capabilities: Count syllables per line with scansion, rhyme gender, caesura and diaeresis alternatives
Check poems against fixed forms such as sonnet, rondeau, villanelle and ballade
Find rhymes filtered by quality, syllable count and grammatical category
Suggest rare theme vocabulary and random rare words with glosses and tags
Look up synonyms, antonyms and definitions from local and online dictionaries
extras: Very thorough README including known limitations and data licences. Downloads a ~210,000-word phonetic dictionary (1.9 MB) from GitHub on first launch; all online sources are opt-in checkboxes and the base dictionary is the only automatic network access. Personal additions live in a user-editable dictionnaire-perso.json that survives uninstall.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in tools for French versification, so poets must count syllables, check rhyme quality and gender, and consult dictionaries outside the app.

relations.evidence: CNRTL (cnrtl.fr) | Definitions, Synonyms, Inspiration | The portal's internal JSON API
Its API: "Synonymes"/"Antonymes" sections; related vocabulary, derived words, etymological relatives
Université de Caen's Dictionnaire Électronique des Synonymes, tens of thousands of curated entries
A French rhyming dictionary with IPA transcriptions
derived from Lexique383, it is shared under CC BY-SA 4.0

summary: French verse companion that counts syllables with scansion, finds rhymes by quality, suggests literary vocabulary, and looks up synonyms and definitions.
